sentences.text:
VERSUS  STATE OF ODISHA Respondent  (FOR ADMISSION )
 Date : 12-07-2024
This petition was called on for hearing today.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUDHANSHU DHULIA  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AHSANUDDIN AMANULLAH

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Avijit Patnaik, Adv.
 Shuvra Mohapatra, Adv.
 Ms. Mohini Priya, AOR  For Respondent(s) Mr. Prakash Ranjan Nayak, AOR  UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R
The petitioner is an accused for the alleged offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 294, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
The petitioner sought anticipatory bail before this Court and by order dated 27.05.2024, this Court granted interim protection to the petitioner.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Accordingly, in the event of the arrest of the petitioner, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail forthwith on the usual terms and conditions to be decided by the concerned Court.
The present petition shall stand disposed of in the above terms along with pending application(s), if any.
